# Fresh compact-default public MEX qualification

The fresh public build passed with the actual promoted source default and no overrides. Both constant-stratification families passed forward/inverse/nonlinear checks, exact storage estimates, schedule/worker metadata and plan lifecycle checks. Maximum relative error was **2.6290663547738235e-15** against a 1e-12 bound. Five focused source-contract/hash/export methods passed. Code Analyzer reported zero new findings; nine existing `PROP` warnings in `TestCompiledKernelIntegration` match the exact 107894a1 baseline.

[The receipt](qualification.json) binds 151 unchanged qualification source/export files and the resulting MEX SHA256. It also verifies the original pinned provider was unchanged and distinguishes original explicit-ON numerical-source equivalence from this newly compiled default-selection proof. The fresh module is `/private/tmp/wvm455-default-qualification/export/wv_compiled_backend_mex.mexmaca64`, SHA256 `b85495a49a8966357ebe4dc79b8d0b64a1394d28d2d37989087c6338bb7285f4`.

[The compressed bundle](qualification-bundle.json.gz) contains exact-source preparation metadata, test/analyzer results, final log, capabilities, reproduction drivers and setup failure history. Every member's normalized text hash and original raw hash is recorded in the receipt; the JSON `files` mapping was decoded and checked against every normalized member hash. Only trailing whitespace/final blank lines were normalized.

The temporary driver initially mishandled an empty struct array, then incorrectly required zero total baseline warnings, and omitted the production provider `.env` file from its minimal export. These were authoring setup failures before compilation, not failures of the promoted kernel. Their logs and drivers are retained. The final public build compiled successfully once. Passing tests and analyzers were reused without repetition.

For a fresh local reproduction, decompress the JSON bundle and write each `files` entry (key is relative path, value is UTF-8 text) under `/private/tmp/wvm455-default-qualification` with no pre-existing `export` directory, then run `python3 prepare.py`, `matlab -batch "run('/private/tmp/wvm455-default-qualification/qualifyFresh.m')" > qualification.log 2>&1`, and `python3 finish.py`. MATLAB must run outside the local Codex sandbox. The drivers require the source checkout and copied-provider prerequisite cache paths recorded in preparation; they refuse source-default overrides or provider rebuild commands. This receipt makes no performance claim; the parent large-grid campaign owns the adoption decision.

The original tar container was replaced after CI correctly rejected its archive suffix under the source-only product rule. This metadata-only conversion preserves every embedded text byte/hash and changes no numerical evidence.
